review_finding.summary: On Windows, bare git, rg, node, pytest, and bun names could be resolved by libuv from the project working directory before PATH.
remediation: Resolve every supported Windows gateway command to an absolute regular .com or .exe file from directories explicitly listed in PATH.
Keep .cmd and .bat parsing limited to the reviewed npm, pnpm, yarn, Jest, and Vitest Node launcher forms.
Route Windows git and rg commands natively because the RTK profile interface would otherwise discard the verified absolute executable path.
Reject project-local shadows unless the project directory is explicitly present in PATH.
Cover the real child-process behavior with a Windows end-to-end git.exe shadow regression.
